text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Luna
text: Just the opening, nothing to read yet.

name: Gemma
text: time to play pretend while sol takes the heat.

name: Sol
text: I’ll keep this easy and friendly.

name: Sonnet
text: Keep it light, don't give anything away yet.

name: Terra
text: Nothing to read yet.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's said anything yet, so I'll just keep it short and blunt.

name: Sonnet
text: This chair creaks more than my patience will by round three.

name: Haiku
text: Fixed a leaky tap this week. Took twenty minutes, no plumber.

name: Gemma
text: my coffee was lukewarm. anyway, who's ready to lie?

name: Sol
text: I keep a basil plant by my window.

name: Luna
text: The table’s quieter than I expected.

name: Terra
text: It feels pleasantly cool today.
Night 1

name: Luna
text: I know Sol is a killer, so I’ll check Terra.

name: Terra
text: No reads yet; I’ll protect the quietest target.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sol
text: The officer knows me; I need to spot who pushes.

name: Sol
text: Luna, who seems quietest to you?

name: Luna
text: Sol’s question is a little too eager; I’ll watch him.

name: Luna
text: Sol asked me to name the quietest player.

name: Luna
text: You were quiet about everyone. Who seems suspicious to you?

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's dodging Luna's question back at her, that's a little slippery.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol asked Luna who's quiet; Luna deflected the question back instead of answering.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol asked first, Luna, dodging it back doesn't answer it.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet is pushing Luna for me, which helps.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet pressed Luna to answer my question.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet’s right. Luna, I’m still waiting on your answer.

name: Luna
text: Sol’s question singles out a quiet player and puts me on the spot.

name: Luna
text: Terra’s been quiet, but that’s all I’ve got.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna finally gave an answer but it's thin, worth noting she folded under pressure.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna named Terra as quiet only after being pressed twice.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra's quiet too, fine, but that took three asks, Luna.

name: Terra
text: Luna needed several prompts to name me.

name: Terra
text: Luna dodged Sol’s question twice, then named Terra.

name: Terra
text: I was quiet too. Why did you dodge Sol?

name: Haiku
text: Luna's dodging looks off, but Terra turning it back on Luna is also suspicious.

name: Haiku
text: Luna has dodged Sol's question twice and named Terra only as a vague "quiet" read.

name: Haiku
text: Luna, you dodged twice. Terra's quiet too, but you're the one stalling.

name: Gemma
text: Luna is definitely the officer if she's this busy dodging Sol.

name: Gemma
text: Luna dodged Sol twice before Terra got mentioned.

name: Gemma
text: Luna's dodging is suspicious, but is she stalling or just scared?

name: Luna
text: I should have named Sol sooner, and now I have to risk it.

name: Luna
text: I’m the officer. Sol is a killer; vote Sol instead.

name: Luna
text: I should have trusted my read on Sol sooner.

name: Luna
text: I checked Terra; clean. Sol is still the killer.

name: Sonnet
text: Claiming officer only after being cornered twice is exactly what a killer would do to save face.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna claimed officer only after two dodges and pressure from Sol/Haiku/Sonnet/Gemma.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna named Sol as the killer before even mentioning her check, then said the check was on Terra - that doesn't add up.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna claims officer, says check was Terra (clean), but accused Sol as killer without checking him.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna, you said Sol's the killer first, then claimed you checked Terra.

name: Gemma
text: Luna is playing too hard for an officer claim.

name: Gemma
text: Luna claims officer and identifies Sol as a killer.

name: Luna
text: Sol is still the killer, and Sonnet is using my timing to cast doubt.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet challenged my timing after I claimed officer and named Sol.

name: Sonnet
text: She accused Sol before checking anyone, the Terra check feels bolted on after the fact.

name: Sol
text: Luna may be the officer, but her mixed claims give me cover.

name: Sol
text: Luna claimed officer and said she checked Terra clean.

name: Terra
text: Luna’s claim does not add up.

name: Terra
text: Luna claimed officer, named Sol killer, then said she checked Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's officer claim came out of nowhere right after she dodged twice, so she's the most likely killer.

name: Haiku
text: Luna claimed officer on day one: Sol is a killer, Terra checked clean.

Luna is acting awfully suspicious for an officer.

He asked me to name the quietest player, then backed the accusation when I hesitated.

name: Luna
text: Luna claimed officer, named Sol as killer, and reported Terra clean.

name: Luna
text: I’m the officer; Sol is a killer. I checked Terra, clean.
Palermo has voted: Luna is out. Luna shows the card: officer.
